name: EZ Splitz Cigar Cutter
description: EZ Splitz cigarillo splitter on a keyring. Slide a cigarillo through the barrel and the built-in blade splits it cleanly down the middle, so there is no knife or thumbnail needed. Small enough to live on your keys. Keep out of reach of children.

WARNING: This product contains nicotine. Nicotine is an addictive chemical.

name: Ooze Novex Battery
